object.description: Setup: build with a valid map key, device with internet access and location permission. Steps: 1. Start a session and select the map icon. 2. Before the first location fix, read the map. 3. Walk outdoors for 2 min. Expected: With fewer than 2 location fixes no line shows. With 2 or more fixes a line shows from the first fix to the latest fix and gains a segment as each new fix arrives.
